# GENERATED FILE. Do not edit by hand.
#   python tools/generate_offices.py
#
# Household offices. See the docstring in the generator for why offices are
# auto_modifiers keyed on country variables rather than traits.
#
# The appoint and vacate effects are parameterised on $OFFICE$ rather than
# generated forty-three times, because Clausewitz substitutes parameters inside
# variable names (cc_bond_aor_effects.txt:34 does the same thing).
#
# WHICH SIDE HOLDS WHAT. The country holds cc_office_<key>_filled (the office is
# occupied), cc_office_<key>_level (published for scales_with) and
# cc_office_<key>_holder. That last one exists ONLY so the panel can print a name:
# GUI can dereference a character held in a variable and script cannot. Nothing in
# this file reads it. The holder instead carries cc_office_held_<key>, so every
# lookup is an iteration filtered by a flag, which is the same shape mentorship,
# patronage, schools and secondment already use.
#
# All effects here run in COUNTRY scope.

# scope:office_holder = the minister being appointed.
cc_office_appoint = {
	save_scope_as = cc_office_court

	set_variable = { name = cc_office_$OFFICE$_filled  value = yes }
	set_variable = { name = cc_office_$OFFICE$_holder  value = scope:office_holder }

	scope:office_holder = {
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_held_$OFFICE$  value = yes }
	}

	# Tenure starts now. Read by the office's scale value and published for the panel.
	set_variable = { name = cc_office_$OFFICE$_since  value = current_year }

	cc_office_publish_levels = yes
}

# Ends the office and clears the holder's flag. The every_character sweep is affordable
# because vacating is rare: it happens on an advance retiring the office, or when the
# holder dies or leaves the cabinet, never on an ordinary tick.
cc_office_vacate = {
	every_character = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_held_$OFFICE$ }
		remove_variable = cc_office_held_$OFFICE$
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_filled }
		remove_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_filled
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_holder }
		remove_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_holder
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_level }
		remove_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_level
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_since }
		remove_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_since
	}
}

# Publishes every holder's level so scales_with can read it. ONE pass over the
# cabinet, not one per office: the inner ifs are variable checks on a character
# already in scope, which is far cheaper than 43 separate iterations.
#
# cc_level (not cc_xp_level) is the 1-10 seniority variable; see the contract
# in cc_xp_effects.txt.
cc_office_publish_levels = {
	save_scope_as = cc_office_court

	every_cabinet_character = {
		limit = {
			in_cabinet = yes

# An advance retired one or more offices. Country-level checks only, no
# character iteration, so this is cheap enough to run on the monthly pulse.
# Fires the notification once if anything was actually wound up.
cc_office_retire_obsolete = {
	set_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  value = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_filled
			NOT = { cc_office_seneschal_exists = yes }
		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = seneschal }
		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_filled
			NOT = { cc_office_master_of_coin_exists = yes }
		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = master_of_coin }
		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}
	if = {

			NOT = { cc_office_herald_of_arms_exists = yes }
		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = herald_of_arms }
		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}
	if = {

# Publishes which offices are open, for the Household panel tab ONLY.
#
# The panel cannot work this out for itself. GUI can dereference a character
# held in a variable, but it has no way to ask whether a NAMED advance has been
# researched: IsResearched exists only on an AdvanceItem handed out by the
# advances screen's own datamodel, and there is no by-key lookup. So the roster
# has to be pushed out as country variables the panel can test with IsSet.
#
# Human courts only. No panel ever renders an AI household, and this is the one
# effect here that exists purely to feed the UI.
cc_office_publish_roster = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_seneschal_vacant = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_seneschal_open  value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_open }
		remove_variable = cc_office_seneschal_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_filled }
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_seneschal_scale_var  value = cc_office_seneschal_scale }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_since } }
			# Held since before tenure existed: count from now.
			set_variable = { name = cc_office_seneschal_since  value = current_year }
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cc_office_seneschal_tenure
			value = { value = current_year  subtract = var:cc_office_seneschal_since  min = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = cc_office_seneschal_scale_var
		remove_variable = cc_office_seneschal_tenure
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_seneschal_exists = yes
			can_research_advance = chancery_records
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_seneschal_retiring  value = yes }
	}
	else = { remove_variable = cc_office_seneschal_retiring }
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_master_of_coin_vacant = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_master_of_coin_open  value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_open }
		remove_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_filled }
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_master_of_coin_scale_var  value = cc_office_master_of_coin_scale }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_since } }
			# Held since before tenure existed: count from now.
			set_variable = { name = cc_office_master_of_coin_since  value = current_year }
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cc_office_master_of_coin_tenure
			value = { value = current_year  subtract = var:cc_office_master_of_coin_since  min = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_scale_var
		remove_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_tenure
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_master_of_coin_exists = yes
			can_research_advance = standardized_coins
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_master_of_coin_retiring  value = yes }
	}
	else = { remove_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_retiring }
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_herald_of_arms_vacant = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_herald_of_arms_open  value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_open }
		remove_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_filled }
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_herald_of_arms_scale_var  value = cc_office_herald_of_arms_scale }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_since } }
			# Held since before tenure existed: count from now.
			set_variable = { name = cc_office_herald_of_arms_since  value = current_year }
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cc_office_herald_of_arms_tenure
			value = { value = current_year  subtract = var:cc_office_herald_of_arms_since  min = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_scale_var
		remove_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_tenure
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_herald_of_arms_exists = yes
			can_research_advance = diplomatic_training
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_herald_of_arms_retiring  value = yes }
	}
	else = { remove_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_retiring }
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_vacant = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_open  value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_open }
		remove_variable = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_filled }
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_scale_var  value = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_scale }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_since } }
			# Held since before tenure existed: count from now.
			set_variable = { name = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_since  value = current_year }
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_tenure
			value = { value = current_year  subtract = var:cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_since  min = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_scale_var
		remove_variable = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_tenure
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_exists = yes
			can_research_advance = absolutist_court
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_retiring  value = yes }
	}
	else = { remove_variable = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_retiring }
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_clerk_of_the_signet_vacant = yes

# AUTOMATION. A post flagged cc_office_<key>_auto (the gear on its card) is
# filled whenever it stands open, by the most senior minister trained for it and
# free of other posts: the same minister cc_office.3 would list
# first. It pays the ordinary appointment price and waits, without unsetting
# anything, while the household is full, the treasury cannot pay or nobody
# qualifies. It never replaces a sitting holder, so tenure is never lost to it.
#
# Plain ifs rather than an else_if chain, so one pass can fill several posts.
# cc_office_filled_count is re-read on each, so the cap holds mid-pass.
# Called from the monthly pulse and when a post is first automated.
cc_office_auto_fill = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_auto
			cc_office_seneschal_vacant = yes
			cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap
			can_pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
			any_cabinet_character = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 } }
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 } }
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = seneschal }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_auto
			cc_office_master_of_coin_vacant = yes
			cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap
			can_pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
			any_cabinet_character = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 } }
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 } }
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_coin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_auto
			cc_office_herald_of_arms_vacant = yes
			cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap
			can_pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
			any_cabinet_character = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 1 } }
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 1 } }
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_auto
			cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_vacant = yes
			cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap

	if = {

			any_cabinet_character = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 } }
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 } }
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = speaker_of_the_elders }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_keeper_of_regnal_chronicles_auto
			cc_office_keeper_of_regnal_chronicles_vacant = yes
			cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap
			can_pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
			any_cabinet_character = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 } }
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 } }
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = keeper_of_regnal_chronicles }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_master_of_the_silk_road_auto
			cc_office_master_of_the_silk_road_vacant = yes
			cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap
			can_pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
			any_cabinet_character = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 2 } }
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 2 } }
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_the_silk_road }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_master_of_ceremonies_auto
			cc_office_master_of_ceremonies_vacant = yes
			cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap
			can_pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
			any_cabinet_character = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 2 } }
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes  cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 2 } }
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		pay_price = price:cc_office_appointment
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_ceremonies }
	}
}

# scope:target = a minister who has just died or left the cabinet. Exact, and
# reached only from on_cabinet_death / on_cabinet_removed, so no iteration is
# needed to work out which office (if any) they held.
cc_office_on_holder_left = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:target ?= { has_variable = cc_office_held_seneschal } }
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = seneschal }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:target ?= { has_variable = cc_office_held_master_of_coin } }
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = master_of_coin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:target ?= { has_variable = cc_office_held_herald_of_arms } }
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = herald_of_arms }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:target ?= { has_variable = cc_office_held_marshal_of_the_court } }
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = marshal_of_the_court }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:target ?= { has_variable = cc_office_held_clerk_of_the_signet } }
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = clerk_of_the_signet }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:target ?= { has_variable = cc_office_held_keeper_of_the_wardrobe } }
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = keeper_of_the_wardrobe }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:target ?= { has_variable = cc_office_held_chancellor_of_the_rolls } }
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = chancellor_of_the_rolls }

	if = {

	if = {

	}
	if = {

# Save migration. Converts a minister still holding one of the six original
# office traits into the matching office and removes the trait.
#
# COUNTRY scope, so it cannot live in cc_xp_init (character scope) the way
# cc_xp_ladder_backfill does. It is called from cc_office_monthly behind the
# cc_office_migrated flag instead, which runs on the first monthly tick after a
# save is loaded. on_game_start would be wrong for the same reason it was wrong
# for the ladder backfill: it does not run when an existing save is loaded.
#
# The six traits are kept as always = no shells in cc_age_traits.txt purely so
# this can read and remove them. See the header there.
cc_office_backfill = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = seneschal }
			cc_office_seneschal_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = seneschal }
			remove_trait = trait:seneschal
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = seneschal }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = master_of_coin }
			cc_office_master_of_coin_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = master_of_coin }
			remove_trait = trait:master_of_coin
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_coin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = herald_of_arms }
			cc_office_herald_of_arms_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = herald_of_arms }
			remove_trait = trait:herald_of_arms
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = herald_of_arms }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = marshal_of_the_court }
			cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = marshal_of_the_court }
			remove_trait = trait:marshal_of_the_court
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = marshal_of_the_court }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = court_chaplain }
			cc_office_court_chaplain_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = court_chaplain }
			remove_trait = trait:court_chaplain
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = court_chaplain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = court_astrologer }
			cc_office_court_astrologer_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = court_astrologer }
			remove_trait = trait:court_astrologer
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = court_astrologer }
	}
}

# APPOINTING FROM THE HOUSEHOLD TAB. Each office's Appoint button flags it with
# cc_office_panel_<key> and fires cc_office.3, whose options are the
# most senior ministers eligible for THAT office. A panel button cannot hand an
# action a character, so the candidates are offered as options instead, the same
# shape as Take On a Protege and Sell a Work. These resolve the flagged office.

cc_office_panel_clear = {
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_seneschal
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_coin
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_herald_of_arms
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_marshal_of_the_court
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_clerk_of_the_signet
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_keeper_of_the_wardrobe
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_chancellor_of_the_rolls
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_the_mint
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_court_chamberlain
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_protocol
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_intendant
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_permanent_secretary
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_director_of_public_instruction
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_court_chaplain
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_court_astrologer
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_grand_inquisitor
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_ecclesiarch
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_qadi_of_the_court
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_court_ulema
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_court_pandit
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_sangha_preceptor
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_consistory_superintendent
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_confessional_overseer
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_steward_of_the_demesne
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_constable
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_consul_of_merchants
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_chancellor_of_the_see
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_keeper_of_the_kurultai
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_the_yam
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_phanariote_secretary
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_hansa_factor
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_postelnic
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_voivode_of_the_court
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_herald_of_the_table_of_ranks
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_state_inquisitor
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_priori_of_the_council
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_jokamachi_warden
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_siege_works
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_keeper_of_the_wampum
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_speaker_of_the_elders
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_keeper_of_regnal_chronicles
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_the_silk_road
	remove_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_ceremonies
}

# Saves up to 4 candidates as scope:cc_office_cand_1..N, most senior first.
cc_office_panel_save_candidates = {
	clear_saved_scope = cc_office_cand_1
	clear_saved_scope = cc_office_cand_2
	clear_saved_scope = cc_office_cand_3
	clear_saved_scope = cc_office_cand_4
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_seneschal }
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_1
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_2
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 2
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_3
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 3
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_coin }
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_1
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_2
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 2
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_3
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 3
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_herald_of_arms }
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_1
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_2
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 2
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_3
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 1 }
			}
			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 3
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_marshal_of_the_court }
		ordered_cabinet_character = {

			order_by = cc_xp_order_seniority
			position = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = cc_office_cand_2
		}
		ordered_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
				cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = mil  TIER = 1 }

# Appoints $WHO$ to the flagged office.
cc_office_panel_appoint = {
	$WHO$ = { save_scope_as = office_holder }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_seneschal }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = seneschal }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_coin }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_coin }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_herald_of_arms }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = herald_of_arms }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_marshal_of_the_court }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = marshal_of_the_court }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_clerk_of_the_signet }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = clerk_of_the_signet }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_keeper_of_the_wardrobe }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = keeper_of_the_wardrobe }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_chancellor_of_the_rolls }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = chancellor_of_the_rolls }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_the_mint }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_the_mint }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_court_chamberlain }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = court_chamberlain }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_protocol }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_protocol }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_intendant }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = intendant }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_permanent_secretary }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = permanent_secretary }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_director_of_public_instruction }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = director_of_public_instruction }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_court_chaplain }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = court_chaplain }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_court_astrologer }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = court_astrologer }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_grand_inquisitor }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = grand_inquisitor }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_ecclesiarch }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = ecclesiarch }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_qadi_of_the_court }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = qadi_of_the_court }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_court_ulema }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = court_ulema }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_court_pandit }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = court_pandit }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_sangha_preceptor }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = sangha_preceptor }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_consistory_superintendent }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = consistory_superintendent }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_confessional_overseer }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = confessional_overseer }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_steward_of_the_demesne }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = steward_of_the_demesne }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_constable }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = constable }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_consul_of_merchants }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_chancellor_of_the_see }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = chancellor_of_the_see }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_keeper_of_the_kurultai }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = keeper_of_the_kurultai }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_master_of_the_yam }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_the_yam }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_phanariote_secretary }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = phanariote_secretary }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_hansa_factor }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = hansa_factor }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_postelnic }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_voivode_of_the_court }
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = voivode_of_the_court }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_panel_herald_of_the_table_of_ranks }

	else_if = {

	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {

	}
	hidden_effect = {
		cc_office_panel_clear = yes
		cc_office_publish_roster = yes
	}
}

# ---- Office events ----
# Yearly. Picks one filled office at random and raises one of its family's two
# events. The office is flagged cc_office_evt_<key> for the event to find.
cc_office_roll_event = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_variable = cc_office_event_cd }
			any_cabinet_character = { cc_office_holds_any = yes }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 30
			set_variable = { name = cc_office_event_cd  value = yes  years = 3 }
			random_list = {
				1 = {
					trigger = { has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_filled }
					set_variable = { name = cc_office_evt_seneschal  value = yes  months = 2 }
					random_list = {
						1 = { trigger_event_non_silently = cc_office.10 }
						1 = { trigger_event_non_silently = cc_office.11 }
					}
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { has_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_filled }
					set_variable = { name = cc_office_evt_master_of_coin  value = yes  months = 2 }
					random_list = {
						1 = { trigger_event_non_silently = cc_office.10 }
						1 = { trigger_event_non_silently = cc_office.11 }
					}
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { has_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_filled }
					set_variable = { name = cc_office_evt_herald_of_arms  value = yes  months = 2 }

						1 = { trigger_event_non_silently = cc_office.10 }
						1 = { trigger_event_non_silently = cc_office.11 }
					}
				}
				1 = {

# In an office event's immediate: save the flagged office's holder and tenure.
cc_office_take_event = {
	clear_saved_scope = cc_office_evt_holder
	set_variable = { name = cc_office_evt_tenure  value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_evt_seneschal }
		every_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = cc_office_held_seneschal }
			save_scope_as = cc_office_evt_holder
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_since }
			set_variable = {
				name = cc_office_evt_tenure
				value = { value = current_year  subtract = var:cc_office_seneschal_since  min = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_evt_master_of_coin }
		every_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = cc_office_held_master_of_coin }
			save_scope_as = cc_office_evt_holder
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_since }
			set_variable = {
				name = cc_office_evt_tenure
				value = { value = current_year  subtract = var:cc_office_master_of_coin_since  min = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_evt_herald_of_arms }
		every_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = cc_office_held_herald_of_arms }
			save_scope_as = cc_office_evt_holder
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_since }
			set_variable = {
				name = cc_office_evt_tenure
				value = { value = current_year  subtract = var:cc_office_herald_of_arms_since  min = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_evt_marshal_of_the_court }
		every_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { has_variable = cc_office_held_marshal_of_the_court }
			save_scope_as = cc_office_evt_holder
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_since }
			set_variable = {
				name = cc_office_evt_tenure
				value = { value = current_year  subtract = var:cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_since  min = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
